detailed_description: The JSON Sorter parses valid JSON and outputs a formatted version with object keys sorted in ascending or descending order. Paste JSON into the input area, choose the sort direction, then click Sort to generate the result. Nested objects are sorted as part of the conversion, while arrays keep their item order. Because the tool uses standard JSON parsing, comments and invalid JSON syntax are not preserved.
usage_steps: Paste valid JSON into the input text area.
Choose ascending or descending key order.
Click Sort to parse and reorder object keys.
Review the formatted JSON in the output area.
If an error appears, fix the JSON syntax and try again.
Use Copy to copy the sorted JSON output.
usage_examples: Sort a small API response so object keys are easier to compare.
Normalize a JSON config snippet before pasting it into documentation.
Reorder nested object keys while keeping array item order unchanged.
Create a consistent formatted JSON sample for a test fixture.
